text: {"lessons":["I made large purchases in the first three periods, including adding more after declines; next time I’ll set position limits and spread purchases over time rather than assume a dip will recover.","Doing nothing through several monthly swings helped me avoid reacting to noise, but I should review my plan regularly and rebalance only when it calls for it.","Selling 20 shares of Stock A at a gain was a useful way to realize some profit, yet my account value still fell afterward; I’ll judge decisions by the whole portfolio and keep my apartment goal and risk tolerance in view."]}
